title: Power button doesn't sleep
line: If the power button doesn't put it to sleep, update your system: it needs steamos-powerbuttond 3.4 or newer.
symptom: On the Xbox Ally models the power button does nothing in Gaming Mode with steamos-powerbuttond older than 3.4.
why: The Xbox Ally models report the power button in a way older steamos-powerbuttond versions don't read.
undo: Nothing to undo: this is advice, GameCove changes nothing.
bazzite: Reports 6036 and 6180 were still open on 2026-11-08; fixed by steamos-powerbuttond 3.4 and newer.

probe.what: Compares the installed steamos-powerbuttond version with 3.4.
